summary: Backend regression tests for EduChat AI lazy-seed refactor. All 9 tests passed in 2.54s against public URL. Root readiness probe is instant (no DB), lazy seed triggers on first /api/dashboard call producing exactly 300 students, and _seeded flag prevents duplicate seeding across repeat calls. Auth, students filter, SSE chat stream, and chat history all verified.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses model 'gpt-5.4-mini' via emergentintegrations - verified reachable (LLM stream returned deltas without error).
_seeded is a module-level flag; if backend has multiple workers each will re-check DB once (harmless due to count_documents guard). Acceptable.
server.py is 500 lines - approaching split threshold but still manageable.
No auth token/JWT enforcement on data endpoints (demo app design).
seed_data_creation: Lazy seed produced 300 students in students collection via /api/dashboard first-call.
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py covers all critical endpoints as regression suite. Rerun with: pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v. Frontend not tested per this request.
